scope.target: Issue #150 repository rename baseline inventory and evidence freeze
constraints: Enumerate tracked current repository content with a reproducible command and pinned Git revision.
Classify every retired-name occurrence using the Issue #150 taxonomy.
Verify material findings against direct repository files and provider read-back.
Keep audited context read-only until the baseline assessment is finalized.
non_goals: Apply remediation before the inventory and finding boundaries are frozen.
Treat every historical old-name occurrence as a defect.
Complete the broader inventories in Issues #170, #171, or #172.

steps: Capture provider-before and Git baseline receipts.
Generate the complete tracked old-name occurrence inventory.
Classify occurrences and verify operational candidates against direct source files.
Create and validate baseline assessment ASM-20260809-001.
Update workflow triage and hand off selected findings to GOV007-002 and GOV007-003.
execution.last_completed_step: Finalized and validated ASM-20260809-001, old-name-inventory.yaml, and provider-before.yaml.
execution.next_action: Remediate AIC-001 and AIC-003 in GOV007-002; implement the AIC-002 gate in GOV007-003; reconcile AIC-004 in GOV007-004.

results.summary: Pinned all 1,010 exact retired-name occurrence lines across 170 files, classified them without overlap, finalized a four-finding baseline assessment, and retained provider-before state.
tests_run: YAML parse for inventory, provider receipt, and assessment locator -> passed
results.residual_risk: The four frozen findings remain open for downstream remediation and verification tasks; signed-in security form and Project Priority are not yet resolved.
